name: EPIC 212557893

text.card: A red giant 1,883 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.81 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,874 K at its surface.
